WITH per_lot AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    MAX(NULLIF(split_part(trim(both '"' from trim(both '{}' from strain_species_strain_from_lot_id::text)), ',', 1), '')) AS species,
    MAX(NULLIF(trim(both '"' from trim(both '{}' from substrate_inputs_from_lot_id::text)), ''))  AS substrate_inputs_txt,
    MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='Inoculated')     AS inoc_at,
    MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='FullyColonized') AS col_at,
    MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='FruitingStart')  AS fruit_at,
    MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='SpawnedToBulk')  AS bulk_at
  FROM public.vc_events
  GROUP BY lot_id
)
SELECT
  lot_id,
  species,
  substrate_inputs_txt,
  inoc_at,
  col_at,
  fruit_at,
  (col_at - inoc_at) AS colonization_duration,
  (fruit_at - COALESCE(col_at, bulk_at)) AS time_to_fruit
FROM per_lot
WHERE inoc_at IS NOT NULL
  AND ({{ selSpecies.selectedOptionValue ? "species = '" + selSpecies.selectedOptionValue + "'" : "TRUE" }})
  AND ({{ selSubstrate.selectedOptionValue ? "substrate_inputs_txt ILIKE '%" + selSubstrate.selectedOptionValue + "%'" : "TRUE" }})
ORDER BY colonization_duration DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50;

    MAX(NULLIF(trim(both '"' from trim(both '{}' from substrate_inputs_from_lot_id::text)), ''))  AS substrate_inputs_txt,
